asset_manifest.pose: An adult male grad student (Caucasian race, short dark hair) wearing a signature thin-rimmed black rectangular pair of glasses, a khaki sun hat, light blue tee shirt, and khaki safari vest kneels with joyful surprise on a wet, dark grey mudflat. He is pointing down at a beautifully clear, five-toed webbed footprint trackway. Nearby, a stylized, friendly Nothosaurus with a sleek seal-like body, webbed feet, and a wide cheerful smile is partially hauled up onto the mud, looking over at him playfully.

visual_notes.text_style: Bright Coral-Orange, high-poly 3D mixed case text with a glossy finish to match the STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3 aesthetic.
visual_notes.ground_texture: Glistening, wet dark grey mineral mud and fine silt with shallow water puddles and ripples characteristic of the coastal MUSCHELKALK formation.
visual_notes.ichnology_spec: The trackway displays distinct semi-aquatic marine reptile impressions (Chirotherium-like tracks): the prints show five thick, splayed toes with faint, curved claw marks at the tips and a soft, curved webbed skin margin membrane visible between each digit. The tracks are sunken negative impressions surrounded by small, glistening mud-heave ridges.
visual_notes.character_consistency: The paleontologist accurately displays the black rectangular glasses, light blue shirt under the vest, blue jean slacks, and black boots as outlined in the core character library.
